items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: I came to New York with a local band which was called Curtis Peagler and the Jazz Disciples.

ctx.x: How does a young man find his way in New York City?
Okay how did I get there. Okay. I went to New York in the fall of 1963. Spring of ’63 I came to New York with a local band which was called Curtis Peagler and the Jazz Disciples. Then they recorded.
He was a sax player, wasn’t he?
